items.text: देव्युवाच देवदेव महादेव महाकारुणिक प्रभो योगिनाम् किं सदा सेव्यम् कौलानां वरपुष्टिदम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: मनश्चाञ्चल्यहरणम् किं समाधिफलप्रदम् वदस्व तदशेषेण यद्यहं तव वल्लभा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शिव उवाच अकथ्यमेतत् चार्वङ्गि देवासुरनरेष्वपि कथयामि तव प्रीत्या गुह्याद्गुह्यतरम् महत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: श्रुत्वा त्वयापि गोप्तव्यम् यत्नेन पशुसंकटे वलो नाम महानासीदसुरो बलवान् पुरा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: जित्वा सुरगणान् सर्वानिन्द्रो ऽभूत्स्वयमेव सः ततः पलायिताः सर्वे भयोद्विग्ना दिवौकसः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पुरंदरम् पुरोधाय मन्त्रयित्वा सुनिश्चितम् नान्यो ऽस्ति तस्मादस्माकम् ततः श्रीमधुसूदनात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: इति संचिन्त्य ते सर्वे प्रययुः परमेश्वरम् संस्तूयमानमृषिभिः सिद्धकिंनरसेवितम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तं दृष्ट्वा पुण्डरिकाक्षं प्रणम्य दण्डवद्भुवि ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयश्चैते देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नमो ऽस्तु हरये तुभ्यम् सर्वदुःखहराय च सुराणामार्तिनाशाय सर्वेशाय नमो नमः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यम् सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तकारिणे गुणातीताय शुद्धाय परतो ऽपि पराय च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: सर्वात्मने नमस्ते ऽस्तु सर्वशक्तियुताय ते सर्वज्ञाय सर्वलोकसाक्षिणे ते नमो नमः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: इति स्तुत्वा च सकलम् तद्वृत्तान्तम् न्यवेदयन् शरणम् त्वाम् गताः सर्वे त्राहि नश्चैव नित्यशः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: दुराचारो वलो मृत्युम् यथा यात्यचिरेण सः रक्षास्माकं च शक्रस्य तथा कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: श्रुत्वेदम् वचनम् तेषामिदमाह पुरंदरम् वृत्तान्तमेतज्जानामि वलस्यास्य दुरात्मनः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ब्रह्मणा न मया वापि न स वध्यः शिवेन वा त्वयैव वध्यो भविता स दुरात्मा न संशयः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एतत्सर्वम् महेशाय निवेदय पुरंदर स एव भगवान् सर्वमेतज्जानाति शंकरः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तवाभिलषितं सर्वम् स विधास्यति गम्यताम् प्रसाद्यताम् च यत्नेन त्वया सौभक्तवत्सलः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अथ प्रणम्य शक्रस्तम् समायातो ममान्तिकमागत्य शुद्धभावो ऽसौ प्रणम्य च कृताञ्जलिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तुष्टाव विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्भक्तिगद्गदभाषितैः कैलासे निवसन्तम् मां ध्यानोपरतमीश्वरम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: स्तोत्रपाठैर्बहुविधैस्तदुद्भवनिनादितैः महद्भिः परितो ज्ञानं सर्वं तदवशेषतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अस्यैव वध्यः स वलो दुरात्मासौ भविष्यति भविष्यमेतद्विज्ञाय शक्रमाहूय संनिधिम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तस्मै तत्परमं ज्ञानम् दत्त्वावोचमिदं वचः त्रैलोक्यविजयाज्ञानमेतत्त्रैलोक्यदुर्लभम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: त्रैलोक्यविजयाज्ञानाज्ज्ञानं नास्ति महेश्वरि अशेषजाड्यहरणं परमात्मप्रकाशनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: अखण्डानन्दनिलयमद्वैतं परमं पदम् मनःस्थैर्यकरं रोगशोकसंतापनाशनम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: बलपुष्टिकरम् सम्यग्योगसिद्धिकरं परम् निषेव्यतामियं संवित्स्थीयताम् च ममान्तिके
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: ततो गत्वा वत्सरान्ते स वलो जेष्यते त्वया इत्येवमुक्तः स मया प्राञ्जलिश्चेदमब्रवीत्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शक्र उवाच देवदेव महादेव सर्वज्ञ सर्वतत्त्ववित् विधिना केन सेव्येयं को वा मन्त्रो विशोधने
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: तर्पणे स्वीकृतौ मन्त्रः संविदः कृपया विभो सर्वमेतदशेषेण साङ्गोपाङ्गम् वदस्व मे
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: श्रीशिव उवाच शृणु शक्र महाभाग सर्वमेतद्वदामि ते श्रुत्वा गोपय यत्नेन तदेवाचर नित्यशः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: त्रैलोक्यविजयाख्याया नामानि प्रथमं क्रमात्कथयामि तव स्नेहात् अतिगुह्यानि सर्वतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: त्रैलोक्यविजया सिद्धा सिद्धिदा सिद्धिमूलिका ज्ञानम् संवित्संविदा च श्यामा भङ्गा रसायना
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: योगदा योगिनाम् सेव्या योगमार्गप्रकाशिनी ब्राह्मणी ब्रह्मसम्भूता ब्रह्मानन्दप्रदायिनी
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: वाग्देवता वशकरी विजया विजयप्रदा समाधिवरदा ज्ञाननाशिनी चैकविंशतिः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: श्वेतरक्तपीतकृष्णपुष्पभेदाच्चतुर्विधा श्वेतपुष्पा ब्राह्मणी सा क्षत्रिया रक्तपुष्पिका
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पीतपुष्पा तु वैश्या च शूद्रा तु कृष्णपुष्पिका आकृष्य पत्त्राण्येतासाम् सबीजानि प्रयत्नतः
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: भर्जितानि घृतेनैव चूर्णितानि शिलातले त्रिकटुत्रिफलाशृङ्गी कुष्ठम् धन्याकसैन्धवम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: शटी तालीशपत्रं च कट्फलं नागकेसरम् यमानीद्वयम् मेथी च जीरकद्वयमेव च
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: एतानि समभागानि रौद्रशुष्कानि चूर्णयेत् गृहीत्वा चूर्णमेतत्तु संविच्चूर्णं तु तत्समम्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: उभयोस्तु समम् कृत्वा सितां संमिश्रयेद्घृते मिश्रयित्वा चतुर्थांशम् समं मधु घृतम् तथा
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).

items.text: पुनः शिलातले पिष्ट्वा त्रिषु गन्धम् प्रवर्तयेत्स्वर्णादिपात्रे पुरतः स्थापयित्वा ततः क्रमात्
items.notes: Source: Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS), Oliver Hellwig, 2010-2024, CC-BY 4.0. Devanagari produced from the DCS IAST transcription via skrutable's transliterator (pip dependency, no vendored code).
